meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Signal 渠道:通过 signal-cli 设备链接,把助手接为你手机上的第二台设备,用原有号码收发 Signal 私聊和群聊。
howto.when: 当你在 /setup 流程中,或要求给助手接入 Signal 渠道时接管。

say.text: 用 signal-cli 设备链接给助手接入 Signal
say.note: 生成链接二维码,用手机扫描一次

say.text: 我扫好二维码了,把链接的手机号存下来
say.note: 记录账号并重启服务绑定

say.text: 把刚出现的 Signal 私聊接给默认 agent
say.note: 查询 messaging_groups 并创建 wiring

howto.what_en: Adds Signal to NanoClaw: links your assistant as a secondary device on your phone via signal-cli device-link, sending and receiving as your existing number for DMs and groups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Signal to the assistant, or while running the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Link Signal to my assistant via the signal-cli device link
say_en.note: Shows a QR link to scan once

say_en.text: I scanned the QR, save the linked phone number
say_en.note: Stores the account and restarts the service

say_en.text: Wire the new Signal DM to the default agent
say_en.note: Queries messaging_groups and creates a wiring
